title: Aureline M5 environment-status-strip component (companion to the remote-target-pill primitive)
description: Companion component schema for the resolved environment status strip projected by the M5 remote-target-pill / environment-status-strip primitive. It documents the shape of one resolved strip: the toolchain / runtime kind, the resolved runtime label / version, the winning runtime source, the resolved scope, the derived readiness state, the effective-value provenance, and the always-present 'Why this context?' entrypoint. The strip never presents a cached, narrowed, or policy-blocked effective value as cleanly ready — its readiness is derived by the resolver in crates/aureline-shell and mirrors the readiness vocabulary in schemas/ui/m5-remote-target-pill.schema.json. Runtime kinds and resolved runtime labels are carried only as opaque, export-safe representations; raw endpoints, tokens, and credentials never cross this boundary. This is a reference contract only; the authoritative packet is validated against schemas/ui/m5-remote-target-pill.schema.json.
